highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the engine to Skia m150 and expands image, color, and paint APIs.
highlights_body: The release adds image-filter factories, overdraw visualization, and fast paint bounds while improving surface access and raster blur rendering. It also completes the v4 obsolete-API cleanup, so check the breaking changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now errors
breaking.body: APIs still marked obsolete before v4 now produce compile errors, and obsolete enums are absent from the reference assembly. Replace affected calls with the supported alternatives identified by their prior obsolete messages.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive support was removed
breaking.body: The deprecated Polyglot Notebooks integration is no longer included. Notebook users must reference SkiaSharp packages directly from a supported .NET Interactive environment.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled rendering engine to the Chrome m150 line and includes a follow-up round of upstream bug fixes.
Adds empty and crop image-filter factories plus an overdraw color filter for visualization workflows.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() so callers can cheaply estimate drawing bounds for quick-reject culling.
Restores expected output for small-sigma raster blur effects affected by the faster raster pipeline.

bullets.lead: Repeated surface canvas access is faster
bullets.detail: SKSurface now reuses its managed Canvas wrapper instead of recreating it on every property access.
Refreshes the bundled text-shaping dependency to HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the v4 obsolete-API cleanup, accelerated repeated SKSurface canvas access, and fixed small raster blurs

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Preview of SkiaSharp 4.150 built on Skia engine milestone 150.
v4.150.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 opens the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: A maintenance preview that finalizes the v4 obsolete-API cleanup, removes .NET Interactive support, and refreshes HarfBuzz.
v4.150.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 completes the v4 obsolete-API cleanup, removes deprecated .NET Interactive support, and updates HarfBuzz.

bullets.text: Promoted remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to errors and trimmed obsolete enums from the reference assembly

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: New image-filter and color-filter APIs, a faster SKSurface canvas path, and a raster blur fix.
v4.150.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 adds image-filter and color-filter APIs, speeds repeated SKSurface canvas access, and fixes small raster blurs.

bullets.text: Cached the SKSurface.Canvas wrapper across calls for faster access
Fixed the small-sigma raster blur rendering regression
